title: list.load request

name.description: Saved-object name in this action namespace; do not assume names are shared by cursors, lists, and protocol configs.

items.description: Signal-path list or alias-to-path/expression map. Expressions must reference aliases rather than nested paths.

signals.description: Non-empty unique final leaf waveform paths in this named list.

items.description: One named collection of unique final leaf waveform signal paths.

lists.description: One or more named waveform signal lists loaded atomically.

mode.description: Action processing or return mode. Its legal values, default, and interactions are action-specific.

timeout_ms.description: Positive public frontend-to-engine request timeout in milliseconds. Omit limits.timeout_ms to disable the public watchdog.

description: Load and validate one or more named waveform signal lists from JSON configuration.
x-description-zh: 从 JSON 配置加载并验证一个或多个命名波形信号列表。
x-purpose: 从 JSON 配置加载命名信号列表。
x-how_it_works: 原子校验 config/config_path 中的 lists、名称、重复项和 FSDB leaf paths，再按 replace/append 写入 ListManager。
x-when_to_use: 在多信号、多时间点查询前加载一个或多个关键观察集合。
x-arg_contract_notes: also one of: config / config_path; optional: mode(default replace)

use_when: Have a schema-valid inline or file-backed JSON configuration for key signals that must be loaded atomically before repeated multi-signal inspection.
do_not_use_when: Do not use it for one ad-hoc list that can be created directly with list.create, or for protocol interface configuration.

alternatives.when: Create one temporary named list directly from a signals array.
Load a valid-ready stream definition with sampling semantics.

constraints: also one of: config / config_path; optional: mode(default replace)
